content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-41. - Costs of unrelated projects.
content.summary:
Nothing herein contained shall be construed as not requiring the segregation of costs
               of unrelated projects for assessment purposes, as herein provided.
(Code 1981, § 27-42; Ord. No. 551, § 16(D), 5-14-1964)
